title: Interoception is analog, the rest of the mind digital

statements.text: The interoceptive system relies mainly on slow, continuous, graded analog-like signaling, which maps the internal milieu in real time. Exteroceptive, motor, cognitive and linguistic systems rely on myelinated, fast, all-or-nothing digital-like signaling.

sources.quote: While interoception relies mainly on analogue-like processing, the other systems favour digital-like signalling.
The slow and continuous integration of information over time in the interoceptive system depends on analogue signalling.
